basis: Post-run editorial classification of the primary requested deliverable in frozen TASK.txt; not a judgment of the worker's actual behavior. One type per scenario, shared by both models. Mixed tasks are assigned by their main deliverable. No independent human validation.
execution_scope: Isolated evaluation workspaces and supplied fixtures. Direct execution in live institutional systems was not tested.

types.label: Planning & design

types.label: Communication & drafting
types.definition: Produce a statement, disclosure, narrative or copy, explaining its relationship to the evidence.
